title: Overlapping compliance policies disagree on BitLocker or Secure Boot

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'overlap disagrees', 'overlaps disagree')} on BitLocker or Secure Boot

messages.businessImpact: Two policies over the same devices disagree on whether encryption or Secure Boot is required, so the estate's effective bar depends on evaluation order rather than on an agreed standard.
remediation: Align BitLocker and Secure Boot on every overlapping Windows policy, or stop targeting the same groups with both.
messages.cannotSee: DifferingSettings uses the derived names BitLocker and Secure Boot. Device count is zero when membership was not resolved; the conflict is still reported. Generic overlaps without those two settings remain CMP-012. Settings Catalog compliance is unread.
